# Standalone build of TigerVNC's common/{core,rdr,network,rfb} for
# Android (arm64-v8a), bypassing tigervnc's top-level CMakeLists.txt (which
# pulls in X11/FLTK/server-only requirements this spike doesn't need).
# Mirrors third_party/ios/CoreSpikeCMakeLists.txt -- see it for the
# reasoning, this is the same approach against the NDK toolchain instead.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10.0)
project(tigervnc_core_android CXX C)

set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/Modules)
include(CMakeMacroLibtoolFile)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} -std=gnu99")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -std=gnu++11")

# core/ requires these even with NLS off (see common/core/CMakeLists.txt);
# leave empty since ENABLE_NLS is not defined for this spike.
set(Intl_INCLUDE_DIR "")
set(Intl_LIBRARIES "")

find_package(ZLIB REQUIRED)
find_package(Pixman REQUIRED)
find_package(JPEG REQUIRED)
find_package(GnuTLS REQUIRED)
find_package(Nettle REQUIRED)

if(GNUTLS_FOUND)
  set(HAVE_GNUTLS 1)
  add_compile_definitions(HAVE_GNUTLS=1)
endif()
if(NETTLE_FOUND)
  set(HAVE_NETTLE 1)
  add_compile_definitions(HAVE_NETTLE=1)
endif()

add_subdirectory(common)
